response.justification: Bogdan brings over 10 years of full-stack experience with deep proficiency in TypeScript, Node.js, React, and cloud tools like AWS CDK, directly aligning with the required stack. His hands-on work with AI-agent infrastructure, testing frameworks, containerization, and open-source tooling demonstrates strong architectural and problem-solving skills. His extensive background in end-to-end development, DevOps, and user-centric delivery further validates his fit for the role.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript, Node.js, React, and AWS
Proven expertise in AI-agent development and internal tooling
Strong DevOps and testing culture with Docker, CI/CD, and Vitest/Jest exposure
concerns: Limited explicit mention of Nest.js or Vitest in resume (though Node/TypeScript experience implies adaptability)
German language skill is only basic, may impact local collaboration
Some roles involve legacy tech (DLang, Ember.js); need confirmation of recent React/Nest.js focus
